name: vendor-review
author: Anthropic and upstream contributors

license.scope: Root LICENSE contains the full explicit Apache-2.0 grant followed by9 anomalous prose lines after the appendix (Syntax-file, code separations, code vault, data/input text). This suffix states no license condition,restriction or contrary ownership, so the complete Apache2 grant is treated as controlling. No operations or small-business child license exists. Exact anomalous root bytes preserved; disclose suffix in redistribution review. Unchanged selected skill/shared files contain no overriding license.
obligations: Retain relevant copyright, patent, trademark and attribution notices; preserve any applicable NOTICE text.
State changes prominently in modified files; license supplies no trademark rights.

assignments.essential_function: Compare suppliers and renewals using total cost,risk,performance and negotiation options.

review: Selected unchanged for evaluating new suppliers,renewals and alternatives: TCO,financial/security/continuity/concentration risk,SLA/support/uptime,comparison matrix and negotiation recommendation. Concise but concrete workflow with proposal-upload and connector options. Proceed/negotiate/pass recommendations are accepted as authored. Scope is analytical decision support; no built-in purchase/payment execution. Root-license anomaly disclosed; no conflicting condition identified.
native_prerequisites: operations/CONNECTORS.md; optional procurement or knowledge-base connections for existing policies/contracts/spend.
User context for purchase,renewal or comparison; source does not supply market data automatically.
